svg.aria-label: ONE API: Chat and text tasks behind one endpoint. The provider is chosen by env: Ollama locally, Anthropic or others in prod. SCOPES: platform-admin, tenant, user. Services enforce the scope on the token, never the prompt. AUDITED STREAM: Tokens stream over SSE. Every answer and tool call is audited
